description_en: Modifies the switchover time of scheduled O&M events for an instance
description_zh: 修改实例计划内运维事件的切换时间
name: ModifyActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the O&M events. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 运维事件 ID，多个 ID 间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled switchover time to set. The time must be in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).


The time cannot be later than the deadline.
You can call the DescribeActiveOperationTasks operation and obtain the deadline from the value of the Deadline response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的计划切换时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）。


不能晚于最晚操作时间。
您可以调用 DescribeActiveOperationTasks，通过返回参数 Deadline 的值来获取最晚操作时间
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to immediately enter the execution scheduling.

Valid values:
0: no (default)
1: yes


If the value is 0, switchTime takes effect. If the value is 1, switchTime does not take effect. The event start time is set to the current time, and the switchover time is automatically calculated based on the new start time.
The event immediately enters the execution scheduling but is not immediately switched over. Preparations for the switchover are performed. After the preparations are completed, the switchover is performed. You can call the DescribeActiveOperationTasks operation and obtain the preparation time from the value of the PrepareInterval response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即进入执行调度。

0：否（默认）
1：是


值为 0 时 switchTime 生效；值为 1 时 switchTime 不生效，事件开始时间将设置为当前时间，切换时间根据新的开始时间自动计算。
事件立即进入执行调度（并非立即切换），进行切换的前置准备，准备完成后，进行切换。您可以调用 DescribeActiveOperationTasks，通过返回参数 PrepareInterval 的值来获取准备时间
parameters.name: immediate_start

Ids.description_en: The IDs of the O&M events. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
Ids.description_zh: 运维事件 ID，多个 ID 间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
